class.name: BehaviorTreeRunner
class.brief_description: Runs behavior tree resources for one AI agent.
class.description: Assign a [BehaviorTreeTask] as [member root_task], configure the optional [member blackboard], then call [method tick] manually or enable [member auto_tick] to update every process frame. On success or failure the runner stops, emits [signal tree_finished], and caches the terminal status. Call [method reset] to run the tree again. Runners maintain independent execution cursors even when sharing the same task resources.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advances the behavior tree using nonnegative [param delta] time. Once completed, returns the cached result without invoking tasks again until reset.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears execution state and restarts the tree on the next tick. The blackboard is preserved.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns true after the root returns success or failure.

method.name: get_last_status
method.description: Returns the latest status or [constant BehaviorTreeTask.RUNNING] before the first tick.

method.name: get_debug_snapshot
method.description: Returns a deep-copied Dictionary with keys [code]status[/code], [code]finished[/code], [code]auto_tick[/code], [code]root_task_class[/code], [code]blackboard[/code], [code]execution_memory[/code], and [code]trace[/code]. The snapshot is made only when requested; editing the copied Dictionaries and Arrays does not change the runner, but Object values inside them remain shared references; do not modify such Objects through the snapshot. Execution memory uses internal node-path keys and should be treated as read-only diagnostic data, not persistent save data or a stable serialized format. Do not send sensitive Blackboard values to untrusted clients.

method.name: set_profiling_enabled
method.description: Enable or disable per-runner timing. A private [AIExecutionProfiler] is created lazily when first enabled.

method.name: is_profiling_enabled
method.description: Whether this runner is collecting CPU timing samples.

method.name: get_profile_snapshot
method.description: Return a detached dictionary of timing statistics. When enabled, category [code]behavior_tree[/code] measures the root task execution and all its child evaluations. Finished runner ticks do not record samples. See [method AIExecutionProfiler.get_snapshot].

method.name: reset_profile
method.description: Reset collected timings without resetting tree execution or Blackboard.

method.name: set_trace_enabled
method.description: Enables an opt-in private [AIBehaviorTrace] for per-node task order, paths, results and inclusive CPU time. The trace object is created lazily and its context does not remain in execution memory.

method.name: is_trace_enabled
method.description: Returns whether this runner is collecting a per-node execution trace.

method.name: get_tree_snapshot
method.description: Builds an on-demand, bounded, detached native task hierarchy suitable for editor docks and in-game Tree controls. The [code]nodes[/code] Array enumerates the root and all Resource occurrences in pre-order, including tasks not visited on the latest tick. Each node has [code]path[/code], [code]task_class[/code], [code]depth[/code], [code]executed[/code], [code]status[/code] (-1 for not visited), and inclusive [code]duration_usec[/code]. The returned Dictionary also includes [code]node_count[/code], [code]truncated[/code] (graph limit 256), [code]trace_truncated[/code], [code]trace_enabled[/code], and [code]tick_index[/code]. With tracing disabled, the complete structure remains available, but all task statuses are not visited. This does not walk the graph automatically on each tick, mutate execution memory or reveal nested GDScript operations inside custom leaf tasks. Never replicate internal task or Blackboard snapshots to ordinary clients.

method.name: get_trace_snapshot
method.description: Returns a detached snapshot of the most recently executed tick, with keys enabled, tick_index, max_steps, truncated and steps. Finished cached ticks do not generate new trace entries. Trace history can contain internal task data and must stay server-side in multiplayer games.

method.name: reset_trace
method.description: Clears saved trace records without resetting execution state, profiler statistics or the Blackboard.

method.name: set_root_task
method.description: Replaces the root task and resets the execution state.

method.name: get_root_task
method.description: Returns the root resource.

method.name: set_blackboard
method.description: Sets the shared blackboard dictionary for this agent.

method.name: get_blackboard
method.description: Returns the shared blackboard.

method.name: set_auto_tick
method.description: Enables or disables automatic processing.

method.name: is_auto_tick_enabled
method.description: Returns whether automatic ticking is enabled.

members.member: Agent-specific shared state available to task scripts.
Process the root task every frame while it is running.
Record root decision time using an opt-in private profiler.
Record bounded, per-node execution traces for the latest tick. No native trace data is collected when disabled.

signal.name: tree_finished
signal.description: Emitted once when the root reaches a terminal status.
